extras: The plugin offers a free version with limited features and a paid lifetime license for full capacity.
intentEvidence: Icons, colours and styling for the Obsidian file explorer — per-file and per-folder icons, regex path masks, and thousands of icons from Lucide, Tabler, Boxicons and Phosphor, plus every emoji.
problem: The standard Obsidian file explorer lacks visual customization for files and folders, making it difficult to quickly identify specific types or paths.
summary: A file explorer styling plugin that adds custom icons, colors, and text styles to files and folders using various icon sets and regex path matching.
